capabilities: Open and edit .csv and .tsv files in a table view
Run SQLite queries against CSV files and insert results into notes
Generate auto-updating bar, line, and heatmap charts from CSV data
Export Markdown tables from whole files, selected columns, or query results
Reformat non-standard CSV files to RFC 4180 with user approval
extras: Ships a bundled native C++ helper (SHA-256 verified) limited to Windows x64, macOS Apple Silicon, and Linux x64; mobile requires a separate csvzall Lite app. The desktop main.js exceeds 5 MB, so Obsidian Sync Standard cannot sync it and the plugin must be installed separately per desktop. Works entirely offline with no telemetry.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to open, edit, query, or chart CSV and TSV files inside the vault.
summary: CSV/TSV viewer and editor that opens delimited files as tables, runs SQLite queries over them, and exports charts and Markdown tables into notes.
